questions.q: What is the main difference this lesson gives between Capstone I and Capstone II?
options: Capstone II requires writing code (Apex, LWC, triggers, tests) rather than configuring declaratively
Capstone II uses a bigger fictional company
Capstone II has fewer requirements than Capstone I
Capstone II does not involve any security model
questions.explain: Capstone I proved declarative configuration skill; Capstone II is deliberately programmatic -- Apex, triggers, tests, LWC, and a REST integration on top of a declarative baseline.

questions.q: What does Solstice Appliance Group sell and service, per this lesson?
options: Commercial kitchen equipment sold B2B only
Software subscriptions with no physical product
Major kitchen and laundry appliances, sold to residential and small-business customers, with an in-house installation and warranty-repair service organization
Only replacement parts, with no direct appliance sales
questions.explain: Solstice sells major kitchen and laundry appliances and runs its own installation and warranty-repair service operation -- the combination that makes this a combined service-and-sales platform.

questions.q: Who on the Solstice platform team reviews the student's code and design decisions throughout the capstone?
options: Renata Okafor, the VP of Sales and Service
Dmitri Volkov, the Director of Customer Service
Jules Thackeray, the Salesforce Administrator
Priya Nandakumar, the Lead Salesforce Developer/Architect
questions.explain: Priya Nandakumar is the Lead Salesforce Developer/Architect who reviews code and design decisions; Jules built the declarative baseline, Renata is the sponsor, and Dmitri owns the service process.

questions.q: According to the Definition of Done table, where does the REST callout integration get built?
options: Chapter 1 -- Design
Chapter 3 -- Build: UI and Integration
Chapter 2 -- Build: Automation and Code
Chapter 5 -- Wrap-Up
questions.explain: The REST callout secured with a Named Credential is listed under Chapter 3, Build: UI and Integration, alongside the Lightning Web Components.

questions.q: What has Jules Thackeray already built before this capstone starts, per this lesson?
options: The complete Apex trigger layer and all test classes
The Lightning Web Components for the technician job board
A declarative baseline: Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, and standard Cases, with basic page layouts and security
The REST integration to the manufacturer warranty network
questions.explain: Jules's baseline covers the declarative groundwork -- standard objects, layouts, and basic security -- which this capstone extends with the custom data model, code, and integration Jules's work doesn't cover.
